title: ProgressIndicator
description: Indicates that something is loading: an indeterminate progressbar drawn as a spinner, circle, wave, bar or dotted bar.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant picks the style: spinner (default), circle, wave, bar or dotted bar.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Five sizes from xsmall to xlarge: the diameter of round indicators or the thickness of bars.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Semantic color: primary (default) or neutral; the special value current follows the surrounding text color (currentColor), e.g. inside buttons.

label.title: Visible label
label.description: A visible label sits next to the indicator and names the progressbar.

width.title: Width
width.description: Set a fixed width, or use full to fill the container.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: Show an icon before the indicator. Always describe what is loading with aria-label.

ProgressIndicatorProps.color: Semantic color of the indicator: theme primary or neutral gray. The special value current follows the surrounding text color (currentColor)
ProgressIndicatorProps.label: Visible text shown next to the indicator; it also names the progressbar unless aria-label is set
ProgressIndicatorProps.aria-label: Accessible label describing what is loading
ProgressIndicatorProps.decorative: Purely visual: drops the progressbar role and hides the indicator from assistive technologies
ProgressIndicatorProps.width: Custom width (ignored when full is set); bars default to 200px
ProgressIndicatorProps.full: Stretches the indicator to the full width of its container

cssVars.--progress-width: Width of a linear indicator with the default width
cssVars.--progress-radius: Corner radius of the bar track (defaults to --radius-sm)
cssVars.--progress-size: Size of the round indicators (spinner / circle / wave; every size)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Five indeterminate indicators. Each is a progressbar named by its label or the localized "Loading".

sizes-colors.title: Sizes and colors
sizes-colors.description: Five sizes; color="current" follows the surrounding text color.

label-width.title: Label, icon and width
label-width.description: A visible label (attribute or slot), an icon slot, a custom width, full width, and a decorative indicator inside a button.

slots.label: Visible label (alternative to the label attribute).
